name: testcatai-code-analyzer
description: Prompt-driven code analysis tool: CLI agent, web backend and UI on top of the GitHub Copilot API

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:agent
scripts.build:backend: cd src/backend-service && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.build:agent: cd src/agent-service && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:backend && pnpm run install:agent
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf src/*/dist && rm -rf src/*/node_modules

author: Alex Slepenkov
